card.name: Frequency words like once and times
card.fires_on: The word right after a count or 'once' that gives how often something happens, such as 'time', 'times', 'once' or 'per' in 'once per day'. It also fires on a comma after 'Once' or 'The first time'.

modes.label: Dose frequency
modes.description: Frequency wording in dosing text: 'once daily', 'once per month', 'one to three times daily'.
modes.example: Diflorasone diacetate ointment should be applied to the affected area as a thin film from one to three<< times>> daily depending on the severity or resistant nature

modes.description: A comma after 'Once' or 'The first time' starting a narrative clause.
